# annoquest

> Guided annotation requests, agent-first: an agent gives a reader documents plus prioritised items (each anchored to a section or passage, each with a response type such as read / agree / implement / approve / comment); the reader is guided through them in a browser, answers autosave and (with a server) autosubmit; the agent collects an aligned / to-discuss / blocked / waiting summary. Or freeform: one link opens any web page to highlight and comment on, every change and page view is an event sent as it happens, and `annoquest export` folds the events into each reader's comments and time per page.

- [README](README.md): install, request JSON, response presets, seams, CLI, server adapter
- [Agent skill](skills/annoquest/SKILL.md): how to build a good request, step by step
- [Spec (Zod, source of truth)](src/spec.ts): Request, Item, ResponseType, Responses, Event, EventBatch
- [Event log](src/events.ts): the fold (final state + reading analytics) and the export
- [Design](docs/design.md): data model, seams and their defaults, surfaces
- [Server adapter](annoquest_server/README.md): API and storage layout, owner commands, the owner page (`mk_owner_app`)
- CLI: `annoquest schema` prints the JSON Schema; `annoquest presets` lists response types; every command prints JSON
